scientific_integrity.claim_type: proved exact finite-network structural classification under stated rate normalization
scientific_integrity.methods: Exact eight-state continuous-time Markov stationary equations and signed polynomial factorization; reproducible symbolic and spanning-tree checks
scientific_integrity.verification_limit: Finite rational evaluations check algebra but do not substitute for the all-positive-parameter Descartes sign proof.

scientific_limitations: Exact three-site chain with equal unit external immigration and local extinction rates, pairwise colonization c>0, and instantaneous stationary objectives only.
No assertion for other source configurations, unequal rates, larger graphs, transient occupancy, or empirical interventions.
Historical priority not independently certified; one relevant finite-SIS manuscript was read only in part.
title: A sharp endpoint–center immigration-site reversal in a three-patch chain
